top_signals.title: Challenger Rejects New $4.4 Billion Daiichi Life Takeover Bid
top_signals.summary: Challenger Ltd. has rebuffed a revised A$6.5 billion ($4.4 billion) takeover offer from Daiichi Life Group Inc., marking the second rejection in a month for the Japanese insurer.
